components.name: CompanyLogoField
components.summary: Admits a local raster image and previews the company's draft logo.
components.usage: Use with the owning company form, which saves the result through the Organizations API. Image selection and removal change the draft only. The API validates the resulting PNG before persistence.
components.accessibility: The native file control keeps its label and format description. Processing and rejection are announced. Discarding a file selection clears validation without removing the current logo.

props.name: id
props.meaning: Unique file control identifier and prefix for help and error descriptions.

props.name: value
props.meaning: Current draft PNG data URL, or null when no logo is set.

props.name: disabled
props.meaning: Disables the file control and draft actions during blocked form states.

props.name: onChange
props.meaning: Receives a prepared PNG or an explicit removal.

states: No logo: Shows a placeholder and offers image selection.
Existing logo: Shows the selected image with replacement and removal actions.
Processing or rejected: Keeps the previous logo and blocks submission until the selection is resolved or discarded.

examples.description: Pass the draft selection and keep submission in the surrounding form.
examples.label: Company settings draft

components.name: ProfileCapabilities
components.summary: Groups delegable access-profile permissions by business area.
components.usage: Use in company profile create/edit forms. It edits the caller-owned draft and keeps viewing prerequisites with dependent actions. It does not submit, grant access or offer company administration.
components.accessibility: Native fieldsets label each area, shared checkboxes keep keyboard semantics, and a status announces the selection count. The caller disables the fields during confirmation, writes and reconciliation.

props.name: onChange
props.meaning: Receives the normalized selection including prerequisites.

props.name: disabled
props.meaning: Freezes selection while the owning form cannot accept changes.

states: Empty: Requires at least one permission before the surrounding form can submit.
Selected: Includes a viewing prerequisite when an action is selected; removing viewing removes dependent actions.
Disabled: Keeps the draft visible during confirmation and recovery.

examples.label: Access profile permissions
examples.description: Compose the selector with the feature-owned draft and submission controls.
